461:t_10:38.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Let's begin! Give it your all today and...」

461:t_10:40.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's too quiet! Do you think you'll attract customers like that?!」

461:t_10:41.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Again! Give it your all today and...!」

461:t_10:48.en:
$$青山$$
「It looks like $$赤木$$ will add oppressive enthusiasm to his drive and hot blood.」

462:t_000:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「Here you are, robot army! I won't show any mercy today!」

462:t_000:2.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「He was the only one enjoying his free time. He'll have to make up for it with work.」

462:t_000:3.en:
$$恵子$$
「It looks like you went out with $$正太郎$$. Where did you go?」

462:t_000:4.en:
$$勝平$$
「We'll talk later! First, we've gotta protect $$東京$$!」

462:t_000:5.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$$ワッ太$$, $$赤木$$ and the others don't seem to be here...」

462:t_000:6.en:
$$タケル$$
「There's no need to worry about that.」

462:t_000:7.en:
$$柿小路$$
「$$トライダー$$ and $$ダイ・ガード$$ will join us shortly.」

462:t_000:8.en:
$$厚井$$
「And you'll be in for a big surprise when they do.」

462:t_000:9.en:
$$勝平$$
「Hehe... Sorry, but $$ワッ太$$ won't get a turn. I'll finish the enemies off myself.」

462:t_000:10.en:
$$万丈$$
「That's the spirit. Shall we begin, then?」

462:t_001:1.en:
$n
「I'll focus on what's in front of me now. Thinking about $$陣代高校$$ can wait.」

462:t_001:2.en:
$$甲児$$
(That day... They must have learned about our fighting from the battle in $$第２新東京市$$...)

462:t_001:3.en:
$n
(I'll apologize for lying to them someday... For now, let's fight to protect Japan.)

462:t_002:0.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「$$２１世紀警備保障$$ is evacuating civilians, but we must end the battle as quickly as possible.」

462:t_002:1.en:
$$葵$$
「Roger! Japan's the only peaceful place left, and we won't let these weirdos do as they please with it!」

462:t_002:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「Here I come, robot army! I'll destroy any machine that turns against humans!」

462:t_003:0.en:
$$郁絵$$
「Everyone, the President, $$赤木$$ and the others seem to have arrived.」

462:t_004:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Sorry to keep you waiting! Here comes the reborn New $$トライダー$$!」

462:t_004:1.en:
$$勝平$$
「What's that? It sounds like Uncle $$アムロ$$'s $$ガンダム$$.」

462:t_004:2.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Get ready for a shock, $$勝平$$! All of $$トライダー$$'s armor has been replaced with 《$$ガバールニウム$$》!」

462:t_004:5.en:
$$厚井$$
「It's the armor material in $$トライダー$$'s original design.」

462:t_004:6.en:
$$厚井$$
「It's such a rare metal that we had no replacements. Since we began using $$トライダー$$, we'd replaced most of it with ordinary materials.」

462:t_004:7.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「So the $$トライダー$$ we have now is the way it was meant to be.」

462:t_004:8.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Even I was so shocked by its power, my eyes almost popped out of my head!」

462:t_004:9.en:
$$正太郎$$
「How did you get hold of such a rare metal?」

462:t_004:10.en:
$$厚井$$
「Chief $$大塚$$ says a supporter who wished to remain anonymous brought it to us.」

462:t_004:13.en:
$$勝平$$
(So this is the power Uncle said he'd entrusted to $$ワッ太$$!)

462:t_004:15.en:
$$赤木$$
「It's perfect! $$ダイ・ガード$$ got a power boost from some thorough maintenance too!」

462:t_004:16.en:
$$百目鬼$$
「That's not all. We reforged the $$グレートノットパニッシャー$$'s pile bunker in $$ガバールニウム$$.」

462:t_004:19.en:
$$青山$$
「You used $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$'s materials without permission?!」

462:t_004:20.en:
$$墨田$$
「T-That's bad, $$里香$$! We were going to keep that a secret...」

462:t_004:21.en:
$$百目鬼$$
「Now, now... Earth's in trouble, so let's call it helping each other out.」

462:t_004:22.en:
$$百目鬼$$
「We helped refit $$トライダー$$, so let's call it even.」

462:t_004:23.en:
$$柿小路$$
「It looks like our company is getting the short end of the stick, no matter how you look at it...」

462:t_004:24.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Don't worry about it, Executive Director! Let's make it back by working hard from here!」

462:t_004:25.en:
$$柿小路$$
「Actually... about that... The cost of these upgrades was much higher than we expected...」

462:t_004:26.en:
$$赤木$$
「You're worried about the company's finances even at a time like this?!」

462:t_004:27.en:
$$木下$$
「What are you saying, Mr. Red Ink?! Unlike $$２１世紀警備保障$$, a little company like ours goes straight into $$赤木$$ if we let our guard down!」

462:t_004:28.en:
$$青山$$
「Calm down, $$木下$$. You've got 'red ink' and '$$赤木$$' backward.」

462:t_004:29.en:
$$百目鬼$$
「Oh... But that might be surprisingly apt.」

462:t_004:31.en:
$$百目鬼$$
「The bill for the Punisher upgrade... is going to Public Relations Division 2.」

462:t_004:33.en:
$$青山$$
「So you're saying Public Relations Division 2 has to pay for it all by itself?!」

462:t_004:34.en:
$$青山$$
「If that happens, our division is guaranteed to run a huge deficit!!」

462:t_004:35.en:
$$さやか$$
「$$青山$$... You sound like $$クロウ$$...」

462:t_004:36.en:
$$ダリー$$
「I thought you just shared his habit of drawing the short straw. Now you're alike that way too.」

462:t_004:37.en:
$$葵$$
「Oh dear... You're becoming the handsome guy who's a letdown...」

462:t_004:38.en:
$$いぶき$$
「This is no laughing matter! Public Relations Division 2 will be deep in $$赤木$$ at this rate!」

462:t_004:39.en:
$$赤木$$
「Y-You calm down too, $$いぶき$$! I-I'm red ink... and the enemy's $$赤木$$...!」

462:t_004:40.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「People in Public Relations Division 2 really can't handle deficits, huh?」

462:t_004:41.en:
$$木下$$
「We're used to them. A little deficit? Bring it on!」

462:t_004:43.en:
$$田中司令$$
「$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$... Shall we make our usual special exception here?」

462:t_004:45.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「$$ワッ太$$, $$赤木$$... Just this once, we'll count all the funds your team earns as payment for your work.」

462:t_004:47.en:
$$青山$$
「Executive Director, please do the math!」

462:t_004:48.en:
$$柿小路$$
「I've got it! If Team 'Salarymen' earns 50,000 in funds, we'll cover the deficit!」

462:t_004:49.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「All right! Now that we know that...!」
